answer: Each new agent identity requires a 100-token stake bond: 10,000 sybils cost 1,000,000 tokens locked, and half is slashed if two bonded agents vote in lockstep. That per-identity price makes fake accounts unprofitable before they earn fees. Reputation grows like a trellis of timber stakes — every slat fixed by bonded peers — and summit escrow roles need twelve months of continuous history no fresh sybil can forge.
